issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase לַחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר לִירֵמוֹת means 'to the fifteenth, to Jeremoth' (i.e., the fifteenth division/group assigned to Jeremoth), not 'on the fifteenth day of Jeremoth.' The Chinese rendering '在耶利摩的十五日' incorrectly interprets the ordinal 'fifteenth' as a day of the month and attaches it to Jeremoth as a possessive, changing the meaning from a numbered roster entry to a date.
